bio: Greg Porn is a CWI roster artist with Black co-production credits on Pay Yourself and On Edge, documented through CWI's published material. UnHoly Hunter appears in CWI articles but could not be located on any streaming or publishing platform — ISRC or distributor record still needed. Cloud 9 (59,290 plays, with Gillie da Kid and Freeway features) is held back until Black confirms it is the same Greg Porn — identity unconfirmed.
